checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices start on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
The basic services line is priced at $2,195 but has no includesText, so the condition requiring includesText is not met.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead fee, with no second staff or facilities fee.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; only the standard embalming disclosure appears.
No D-alt-container disclosure is transcribed in the disclosures array.
Direct cremation is offered with an option using a container provided by the purchaser, and no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation includes text lists transportation to crematory and cremation, and no cash-advance crematory fee is shown to evaluate.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or description.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not treated as packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No text claims that a product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the transcribed disclosures use standard wording.
